arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project/src'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import t_showcase as t
from eywa.wire import decode, assign
from eywa.offline import Campaign
doc = dict(t.doc)
doc["runs"] = []
c = Campaign(doc)
run = t.payload([("read", 3), ("write", 7)], "abc", t.STATES["done"], "hi", 1, 0)
objs = decode(run["ktest"])
print("objects", len(objs))
try:
    assign(objs, c.plans[0].harness.leaves)
    print("assign ok")
except Exception as e:
    print("assign failed:", e)
    present = {n for n, _ in objs}
    expected = set(c.plans[0].harness.leaves)
    print("missing", sorted(expected - present))
    print("extra", sorted(present - expected))
    for n, d in objs:
        print(n, len(d), c.plans[0].harness.leaves.get(n))
PYEOF
